# Erkan Pulat

> Software engineer Erkan Pulat in Istanbul. Web, mobile, and AI product development with ODAKOD Yazılım (https://odakod.com/). Projects include QuotaCrew for Codex, Radyotara for web and Android, and Kelime Tahmin Oyunu.

Turkish and English content is available. QuotaCrew for Codex is the current name of Codex Account Manager. Its canonical project pages use /projects/quotacrew/ and /en/projects/quotacrew/. The former account-manager URLs redirect to them.

Radyotara's website and Android app are editions of the same radio frequency guide, not separate products. Both are developed by Erkan Pulat. The Android package is com.radyotara.app; the canonical Google Play listing is https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.radyotara.app. Radyotara does not host live radio streams. QuotaCrew is a Windows application, not an Android app; Kelime Tahmin Oyunu is a web game.

## Portfolio

- [Erkan Pulat — Türkçe](https://erkanpulat.github.io/index.md): Career, engineering experience, projects and public contact links, generated from the Turkish portfolio content.
- [Erkan Pulat — English](https://erkanpulat.github.io/en/index.md): English career, projects and contact reference, generated from the English portfolio content.

## QuotaCrew for Codex

- [QuotaCrew — Türkçe](https://erkanpulat.github.io/projects/quotacrew/index.md): Codex account and quota management, switching, experimental Desktop/VS Code continuation, job tracking, setup and privacy.
- [QuotaCrew — English](https://erkanpulat.github.io/en/projects/quotacrew/index.md): English product reference, features, supported scope and limitations.
- [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NM4VKLKS9PF): Install QuotaCrew for Codex from Microsoft Store.
- [Windows downloads](https://github.com/erkanpulat/codex-quotacrew/releases/latest): Official project release page for this independent MIT-licensed application.
- [Source code](https://github.com/erkanpulat/codex-quotacrew): QuotaCrew source and documentation.
- [Codex usage guide — Türkçe](https://erkanpulat.github.io/projects/quotacrew/codex-usage-limits/index.md): Checking current limits, reset times and a quota-interrupted workflow.
- [Codex usage guide — English](https://erkanpulat.github.io/en/projects/quotacrew/codex-usage-limits/index.md): Official usage references and a practical QuotaCrew workflow.

## Other projects

- [Radyotara — Türkçe](https://erkanpulat.github.io/projects/radyotara/index.md): Radio frequency directory and Android app, with Google Play download.

- [Radyotara on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.radyotara.app): Android edition published by Erkan Pulat.
- [Kelime Tahmin Oyunu — Türkçe](https://erkanpulat.github.io/projects/kelime-tahmin-oyunu/index.md): Turkish word game, KTO Atlas geography and KTO İmla spelling.
